In the past few weeks, we've had several waves of new people who heard about voat and came to check it out. This announcement is a friendly reminder that voat is running in early alpha stage where things are usable but highly experimental. We are adding new features almost on a weekly basis, changing existing features and fine-tuning various back-end mechanics which make voat tick. Voat is a student side-project, and quite a few people are not aware of the fact that we have no income from voat and that simply having voat up and running is costing us significant amount of money (especially for a very limited student budget), not to mention thousands of hours spent on voat development which could otherwise be used on part time jobs along our studies.

Whenever we make a change on existing voat mechanics or add a new feature, the change is not necessarily permanent and it is always open for debate. It is impossible to please every single user and that is perfectly natural, however, if you as a user want your voice to be heard by voat developers and contributors, we urge you to use subs like /v/voatdev or /v/ideasforvoat and voice your opinion by starting new discussions or actively participating in ongoing discussions.

Thank you for trying voat and please try not to break anything :) If you discover a vulnerability, please don't disclose it publicly and send us an email instead (contact info can be found here).
